baseline.method: Unmodified published2015authorDRC on full512x512realOCT observations; method reference, not actual truth

forward_residual_definition: L2 norm of J/(2dz)-mu*S divided by norm of J/(2dz), over all rows except final; S is reverse sum of public-signal-derived corrected J through the penultimate row. Exact selected estimator identity, not an independent physical-truth metric.
reference_role: Original method output, no actual measured attenuation truth available
tolerance_provenance: Nonzero numerical tolerances frozen before extraction; independent native repeat and low-level later author GitHub implementation agree bitexact; independent physical cell-integral checks characterize Riemann bias. No endpoint crop or fitted alignment during scoring.
